AiContext.description:
Everything a model is allowed to know about the freelancer, and nothing else.

Built from the freelancer's own profile fields plus knowledge items that are BOTH approved and enabled.
Draft, pending-review, rejected and disabled items are excluded; only their counts are reported.
AiContext.title: AiContext

OpportunityPatch.description:
PATCH semantics: omitted = unchanged, null clears an optional field. Stage and status change only through
the move/reopen actions so every change is checked and written to the timeline.
OpportunityPatch.title: OpportunityPatch

ProfilePatch.description: PATCH semantics: omitted fields are untouched; ``null`` or an empty value clears the field.
ProfilePatch.title: ProfilePatch

ProfileSummary.description: Plain-text, public-facing professional summary composed ONLY from fields the freelancer entered.

keywords.description: Extra words that signal a project you want, besides your profile's services.

TagUpdate.description: PATCH semantics: omitted fields are left unchanged.

due_at.description: With an offset/Z it is an exact instant. Without one it is wall-clock time in due_timezone.
due_at.title: Due At

due_timezone.description: IANA zone the time was meant in. Defaults to the profile's time zone.
due_timezone.title: Due Timezone

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key to retry safely: the same task comes back instead of a duplicate.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

remind_at.description: Same rules as due_at. Must not be after due_at.
remind_at.title: Remind At

TaskPatch.description: PATCH semantics. Status changes use the complete / reopen / dismiss actions.
TaskPatch.title: TaskPatch
